IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark brown hair in a
low, loose updo with soft strands at her temples
stands against a pale white backdrop. She wears a
black tailored blazer with wide notched lapels over
a sheer black mock-neck top. Her expression is
calm and direct, with soft pink lips. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of black, ivory, and soft rose.
Sharp and modern, in the style of a minimalist
tailoring campaign.
